_comment: SYNTHESIZED GitLab fixtures. The real GitLab notes this grammar was measured on live in a
company repository (minervaai/minerva-skills) whose note bodies must NOT be vendored into this
public repository. These bodies are written by hand to carry the SHAPES that the real ones
showed: list-item fields (``- Reviewer:``), a symbolic-base scope (``main..72bea95``), the
``changes-required`` verdict, ``- Verdict: Approve``, a remediation table, and an
``APPROVE — TERMINAL`` sign-off. Every id, SHA and sentence here is invented.

3974547000.body:
### Agent review — round 1

- Reviewer: reviewer subagent, model `vendor/model-x`
- Scope: `main..72bea95` — the three changed files plus their direct importers.
- Verdict: **changes-required (1 major)** — the refusal path answers 200.

**F1 (MAJOR) — a refused write still answers 200.** The route returns the store's
receipt without asking whether the write landed, so a caller reads success.

**F2 (MINOR)** — the docstring still names the old op.

Reviewed on `72bea95`, the branch head at review time.

3974547001.body:
### Agent review remediation — round 1

| Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|
| **F1** (MAJOR) | **fixed (`0c1d2e3`).** The route now asks the store for the durable outcome and answers 409 with `write_refused` when the write did not land. |
| **F2** (MINOR) | **fixed (`0c1d2e3`).** Docstring renamed. |
| **F3** (NIT) | **deferred** — wording of the log line; a follow-up ticket on the board, not this MR. |

Head is now `0c1d2e3`.

3974547002.body:

- Reviewer: reviewer subagent, model `vendor/model-x` — no fallback this round.
- Scope: `72bea95..0c1d2e3` — the remediation delta only; nothing else re-audited.
- Verdict: APPROVE — TERMINAL.

**F1 (MAJOR) — verified fixed.** Reproduced the refusal first (`409 write_refused`), then the
success path (`201`) on the same head. No new findings; nothing outside the delta was re-read.
